WITH film_copies AS (
  SELECT 
    f.film_id,
    f.rating,
    COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count
  FROM film f
  LEFT JOIN inventory i ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(copy_count) AS rating_avg
  FROM film_copies
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS overall_avg
  FROM film_copies
)
SELECT 
  fc.film_id,
  fc.rating,
  fc.copy_count,
  fc.copy_count - ra.rating_avg AS diff_from_rating_avg,
  fc.copy_count - oa.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg
FROM film_copies fc
JOIN rating_averages ra ON fc.rating = ra.rating
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
